d: Your internship begins with a two-week online training program designed to teach you the fundamentals of the U.S. domestic logistics industry and how freight moves across the country.

Following training, you will transition into a 3-to-4-month remote internship, working Monday through Friday from 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM. You will be paired with a dedicated mentor who will guide your growth and show you the ropes of inside sales. Your primary focus will be prospecting and booking sales meetings for your mentor to help close. You will earn $30 for every completed meeting (where the prospect attends)—meaning the more qualified meetings you book, the more you earn.

Once you begin bringing in clients, you will also learn the operational side of logistics, including how to coordinate and move freight for the accounts you helped secure. At the end of the program, the top four performers in the intern class will be invited to interview for full-time positions on our team.
